wrap_module_with_fsdp: wrap a PyTorch module in FullyShardedDataParallel using fsdp_wrap with optional min_num_params threshold
enable_fsdp_wrap_context: enable FSDP wrapping context using fsdp_enable_wrap with a DistributedTrainingConfig for model building
save_fsdp_state_dict: save the FSDP model state dict using state_dict with sharded or full rank 0 mode
load_fsdp_state_dict: load the FSDP model state dict using load_state_dict with sharded or broadcast from rank 0
create_dummy_process_group: create a DummyProcessGroup with a given rank and size for single-GPU FSDP fallback
